summary.intent: Execute Phase 27 (writable-shares-poc) end-to-end: implement API backend, owner UI, and recipient write UI for IPFS/IPNS-based writable folder sharing, then conduct UAT, security review, and fix all identified issues.
summary.outcome: All 3 plans executed and verified. Four UAT bugs and 8 security issues were identified and fixed, 18 E2E tests written and passing, security review report created, and all changes pushed to remote.

repo: cipher-box-ci-debug is a separate checkout from cipher-box and does not share .env files — they must be copied manually or created from .env.example
The web app falls back to `window.location.origin + '/api'` when VITE_API_URL is unset, causing it to call port 5173 instead of 3000
SDK packages (core, sdk-core, sdk) must be built before the web dev server can start — missing builds cause unresolvable import errors
SharedFileBrowser uses an inline mkdir input (.shared-inline-input-field) rather than a modal dialog, unlike the owner FileBrowser
Recipient permission label CSS class is .recipient-perm-write/.recipient-perm-read, not .share-recipient-permission
Rename in SharedFileBrowser uses .shared-inline-rename-field for the inline input

There are two incompatible RequestWithUser types: one in common/types.ts (extends Express Request) and a local one in auth.controller.ts (extends NestJS Fetch API Request) — the auth controller should use the shared common type
NestJS watch mode does not always pick up DTO enum changes for OpenAPI spec generation — API restart + client regeneration is required
The @Request() decorator import from @nestjs/common must be preserved even when switching to a shared RequestWithUser type

code.finding: Shared uploads were setting fileMetaIpnsName: '' — no per-file IPNS record was created, making files unreadable after upload
TextEditorDialog throws 'File metadata IPNS name not available (legacy v1 file?)' when fileMetaIpnsName is empty — manifests for shared-uploaded files
withConflictRetry closures captured stale React state for currentSequenceNumber and folderChildren — fixed by using refs synced on every state update (C-01)
createFileMetadata zeroes out the IPNS private key internally, so dual-key wrapping (owner + recipient) requires inlining keypair generation rather than calling createFileMetadata
addShareKeys DTO originally constrained keyType to 'file' | 'folder' only — needed 'file-ipns' added to store recipient-wrapped IPNS private keys separately
Owner's handleUpdateFile did not re-wrap the new file key for share recipients after editing — reWrapForRecipients must be called after every file content update, not just initial uploads
Permission downgrade did not delete file-ipns share_keys, allowing recipients to retain IPNS write access after being downgraded (H-03)
auth.controller.ts defined a local RequestWithUser extending @nestjs/common Request (Fetch API) instead of using common/types.ts RequestWithUser (Express) — caused type incompatibility across specs

workflow: Background tasks in Claude Code get killed when conversation context shifts — use detached processes (nohup or disown) for dev servers that need to persist
TDD flow for security fixes: stash partial fixes, write failing tests, restore stash, verify green — confirms tests actually catch the vulnerability
NestJS API client regeneration (openapi-generator) requires the API to be running with updated DTOs before the spec reflects enum changes
When a background agent completes but the orchestrator never receives the signal (classifyHandoffIfNeeded bug), spot-check SUMMARY.md + git commits to determine real success

friction: Background API and web dev server tasks were repeatedly killed by conversation context shifts, requiring 4+ restart cycles
PostgreSQL host IP changed mid-session (192.168.133.114 → 192.168.133.12), requiring .env update before API could connect
cipher-box-ci-debug had no .env files and no documented setup process — had to discover missing files through runtime errors
Git lock file blocked commit after conflict retry work, required manual removal
NestJS watch mode did not hot-reload DTO enum changes — wasted time debugging why OpenAPI spec still showed old enum values
Two incompatible RequestWithUser types caused a cascade of type errors during the pre-existing auth controller fix
E2E test selectors required 5 iteration cycles to get right — actual CSS class names differed from expected in 3 places
open_items: E2E security tests for C-02 (owner access to recipient-created subfolders) depend on folder navigation not yet implemented for nested shared folders
Silent revocation (403 handling → [RW] to [RO] transition with key zeroing) was listed as a UAT item but not confirmed tested
30-second polling detection of permission changes was added to E2E suite but relies on real IPNS propagation timing — may be flaky in CI
Pre-existing TypeScript errors in device-approval.controller.spec.ts were not fixed (out of scope)
The dual-IPNS-key wrapping approach (owner in FilePointer, recipient in share_keys) is a PoC design — a production implementation should unify the key storage model
Re-wrapping share_keys after owner file edits (reWrapForRecipients) fetches all share recipients on every save — should be optimized for folders with many shares
Security finding H-01 (write-share recipient can overwrite TEE enrollment) fix was applied to API but no automated test covers the TEE publish path specifically
